queries: On a complex manifold X, for a plurisubharmonic function phi and a prime divisor E over X, with multiplier ideals defined by |f|^2 exp(-phi) locally integrable and Lelong numbers normalized by nu(log|z|^2,0)=1, one has nu(phi,E)=lim_{k->infinity} (1/k) ord_E I(k phi). Consequently equality I(lambda phi)=I(lambda psi) for every lambda>0 implies equality of Lelong numbers; on a Riemann surface this equals the atomic mass of ddc phi for ddc=i/(2pi) partial barpartial.

Let X be a connected compact Kähler manifold and theta a closed smooth real (1,1)-form representing a big cohomology class. For phi in PSH(X,theta) with positive non-pluripolar mass, the following are equivalent: phi is the d_S limit of potentials with analytic singularities; its non-pluripolar mass equals the volume defined by multiplier ideals; P_theta[phi]=P_theta[phi]_I.

results.title: The Dynamical Manin-Mumford Conjecture and the Dynamical Bogomolov Conjecture for endomorphisms of (P^1)^n
results.theorem:
Let $r_{1}$ and $r_{2}$ be positive real numbers and let $u_{1},\cdots,u_{n}$ and $u$ be continuous subharmonic functions on $D(0,r_{1})$, respectively on $D(0,r_{2})$. Let $\theta$ be a holomorphic map from $D_{n}(\tilde{0},r_{1})$ to $D(0,r_{2})$ and moreover, assume the following two $(n,n)$-currents satisfy the relation:



$dd^{c}u_{1}(x_{1})\wedge\cdots\wedge dd^{c}u_{n}(x_{n})=c_{0}\cdot dd^{c}u_{1}(x_{1})\wedge\cdots\wedge dd^{c}u_{n-1}(x_{n-1})\wedge dd^{c}u\circ\theta(\tilde{x})$



on $D_{n}(\tilde{0},r_{1})$ for some constant $c_{0}>0$. Then for any given point $\underline{\alpha}$ in the support of $dd^{c}u_{1}(x_{1})\wedge\cdots\wedge dd^{c}u_{n-1}(x_{n-1})$, we have the following equality of $(1,1)$-currents on $D(0,r_{1})$:



$dd^{c}u_{n}(x_{n})=c_{0}\cdot dd^{c}u\circ\theta(\underline{\alpha},x_{n}).$

results.title: Toric plurisubharmonic functions and analytic adjoint ideal sheaves
results.theorem:
Let $D$ be an SNC divisor on a smooth complex manifold $X$, $\mathfrak{a}$ an analytic ideal sheaf on $X$ not containing any of the ideals of the components of $D$, $c>0$ a real number and $\varphi_{c\cdot\mathfrak{a}}$ be a psh function attached to $\mathfrak{a}^{c}$. Then the following equality of sheaves holds:



$\mathcal{A}dj_{D}(\varphi_{c\cdot\mathfrak{a}})=\mathrm{Adj}(\mathfrak{a}^{c},D).$

results.title: On Lelong Numbers of Generalized Monge-Ampère Products
results.theorem:
Let $\pi\colon X\rightarrow Y$ be a proper holomorphic submersion,
let $T$ and $\theta$ be closed quasipos current with analytic singularities of bidegree $(p,p)$ and $(1,1)$, resp. Let $\eta_{1},\eta_{2}$ be two quasipos $(1,1)$-currents with neat analytic singularities in isolated points both in the same $\partial\overline{\partial}$-class as $\theta$ such that $\nu(\eta_{1},x)=\nu(\eta_{2},x)$ for all $x\in X$. Then, for all $y\in Y$, we get



$\nu\big{(}\pi_{\ast}([\theta]_{\eta_{1}}^{k}\wedge T),y\big{)}=\nu\big{(}\pi_{\ast}([\theta]_{\eta_{2}}^{k}\wedge T),y\big{)}.$

results.title: Kähler-Einstein metrics on stable varieties and log canonical pairs
results.theorem:
Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold of dimension $n$, $dV$ some volume form, $D=\sum a_{i}D_{i}$ a $\mathbb{R}$-divisor with coefficients in $(-\infty,1]$ and defining sections $s_{i}$, $E=\sum c_{\alpha}E_{\alpha}$ an effective $\mathbb{R}$-divisor such that $D_{red}+E$ has snc support, and $\theta$ a semipositive form with $\int_{X}\theta^{n}>0$ such that $\{\theta\}-c_{1}(E)$ is a Kähler class. Then the $\theta$-psh function $\varphi$ with full Monge-Ampère mass, which is a solution of



$\langle(\theta+dd^{c}\phi)^{n}\rangle=\frac{e^{\varphi}dV}{\prod_{i}|s_{i}|^{2a_{j}}}$



is smooth outside of $\mathrm{Supp}(D)\cup\mathrm{Supp}(E)$.

results.title: Duality between the pseudoeffective and the movable cone on a projective manifold
results.theorem:
Let $\theta$ be a smooth closed real $(1,1)$-form on a compact Kähler manifold $(X,\omega)$. Assume that the class $\alpha:=[\theta]$ is big and let $\psi_{0}$ be a strictly $\theta$-psh function with analytic singularities. Let $\phi$ be defined as



$\phi:=\sup\{\psi\leq 0:\psi\in PSH(X,\theta)\},$



and let $D:=\{\phi=0\}$. Then $\phi\in PSH(X,\theta)$ has minimal singularities and for some constants $C$ and $B$ we have that



$|dd^{c}\phi|_{\omega}\leq C(|\psi_{0}|+1)^{2}e^{B|\psi_{0}|}.$



It follows that



$\operatorname{MA}_{\theta}(\phi)=\mathbbm{1}_{D}\theta^{n}$



and hence



$\operatorname{vol}(\alpha)=\int_{X}\operatorname{MA}_{\theta}(\phi)=\int_{D}\theta^{n}.$

results.title: Envelopes with Prescribed Singularities
results.theorem:
Let $X$ be a compact Kähler manifold and $\theta,\gamma$ two closed real $(1,1)$-forms on $X$ such that $[\theta]$ is big, $[\gamma]$ is pseudoeffective, and $[\theta-\gamma]$ is nef. Suppose also that $u\in C^{\infty}(X)$ and $\psi\in PSH(X,\gamma)$ with analytic singularities. Then if either:


(1)

$[\theta-\gamma]$ is big, or



(2)

$\int_{X}\langle(\gamma+\sqrt{-1}\partial\overline{\partial}\psi)^{n}\rangle>0,$



we have that $P_{[\psi]}(u)\in C^{1,1}_{loc}(X\setminus Y)$, where $Y\subset X$ is a proper analytic subset given either by $Y=E_{nK}(\theta-\gamma)\cup\mathrm{Sing}(\psi)$ in case $(1)$, or by $Y=\mu(E_{nK}(\widetilde{\gamma}))\cup\mathrm{Sing}(\psi)$ in case $(2)$ (where $\widetilde{\gamma}$ and $\mu$ are defined in (2.1) below).

reference_checks.application: Class invariance, ideal preservation and idempotence give the bijection. Normalization puts the representatives in K_theta.

reference_checks.context_expansion: This is compactness of the normalized family itself, including sup=0 for the canonical limit, not merely compactness modulo constants.
reference_checks.application: Sup-normalized Green potentials stay in the same background; all their L1 cluster limits have sup zero. On general X the compact complete closure gives the metric completion.
